Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Debashish Sen. I am a 59-year-old shopkeeper living in Kochi. Saxena Enterprises gave me a cheque for 14.6 lakh rupees to repay a loan, but the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds. My case number is S.C.C. No. 547/2019 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kochi. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 62992 18193 or email debashish.sen53@example.com.
